notes: Phobos Banking story pack (0.5.0 draft): five lenders, their place-less letter threads, twenty event arcs, home adverts and news, local small talk, and a spacer-life article. Letters cannot alter the ledger; payment remains in the Finances window.

bank-corvane-mutual-borrowed.title: Corvane Mutual: a new loan
bank-corvane-mutual-borrowed.notes: Started by Phobos Banking when the player borrows from Corvane Mutual.

message.text: Welcome to Corvane Mutual, [player-first]. Your loan is on our books and the money is in your account. The first instalment is already on your ledger; the rest come by the shift. Pay them in your Finances window and we will get along fine.

bank-corvane-mutual-late.title: Corvane Mutual: a late bill
bank-corvane-mutual-late.notes: Started by Phobos Banking when a Corvane Mutual bill turns late. The reply changes nothing in the ledger; the game's late fee stands either way. Variants after the first are agent placeholders (Framework 0.132.0 proof) for the writers to replace.

text: [player-first], one of your bills to Corvane Mutual has gone past its shift. The station adds its late fee at every shift change it stays unpaid, and there is nothing I can do about that. Can we expect it soon?

[player-first], a bill of yours to Corvane Mutual is still open past its shift. The station adds its late fee at each shift change until it is paid; that part is out of my hands. When can we expect it?

choices.label: It will be paid this shift

message.text: Good. Every bill is in your Finances window, oldest first. Thank you, [player-first].
Noted. I cannot stop the late fee; that is the station's rule, not ours. Pay what you can, when you can, and keep me informed.

bank-corvane-mutual-late-long.title: Corvane Mutual: still unpaid
bank-corvane-mutual-late-long.notes: Started by Phobos Banking when a Corvane Mutual bill has been late for three game days.

message.text: [player], your bills to Corvane Mutual have been late for days and the fees grow every shift. We have no wish to make this harder than it is. Pay what you can in your Finances window, the oldest first, and the rest will follow.

bank-corvane-mutual-repaid.title: Corvane Mutual: paid in full
bank-corvane-mutual-repaid.notes: Started by Phobos Banking when a Corvane Mutual loan is repaid. A small standing gain with OKLGCorp through the game's own faction score.

message.text: Paid in full, [player-first]. Corvane Mutual thanks you. Word of a good borrower gets around the yards, and our door stays open.

bank-halcyon-bond-borrowed.title: Halcyon Bond: A new loan
bank-halcyon-bond-borrowed.notes: Started by Phobos Banking on the borrowed event; letters and replies do not change the debt.

message.text: Captain [player-first], thank you for placing your business with Halcyon Bond. Your loan is on the ledger, with payments due by the shift. Please keep the schedule in your Finances window close at hand; orderly accounts make for a better relationship.

bank-halcyon-bond-late.title: Halcyon Bond: A late bill
bank-halcyon-bond-late.notes: Started by Phobos Banking on the late event; letters and replies do not change the debt.

message.text: Captain [player-first], one Halcyon Bond bill has passed its shift. The late fee is added at each shift change while it remains unpaid. Your Finances window shows what is due. Shall I note that payment is coming, that you need time, or that you cannot say yet?
Thank you for telling me. The ledger continues on its own schedule; please make any payment through Finances.

choices.label: Please note that I need time

message.text: I understand. I cannot alter the bill or its fee. The amount due remains in Finances.

choices.label: I cannot give you an answer today

message.text: Understood. I would rather have a plain answer than a polished one. The outstanding bill remains on your ledger.

bank-halcyon-bond-late-long.title: Halcyon Bond: Still unpaid
bank-halcyon-bond-late-long.notes: Started by Phobos Banking on the late-long event; letters and replies do not change the debt.

message.text: The oldest Halcyon Bond bill has now been unpaid for three days. The late fee continues to be added at each shift change. I would prefer our next letter to concern an account in good order. Please check the balance in Finances when you can.

bank-halcyon-bond-repaid.title: Halcyon Bond: Paid in full
bank-halcyon-bond-repaid.notes: Started by Phobos Banking on the repaid event; letters and replies do not change the debt.

message.text: Your Halcyon Bond loan is paid in full, Captain [player-first]. Thank you for bringing the account to a proper close. The balance should now read as cleared in Finances.

bank-aerie-savings-borrowed.title: Aerie Savings Union: A new loan
bank-aerie-savings-borrowed.notes: Started by Phobos Banking on the borrowed event; letters and replies do not change the debt.

message.text: Hello, [player-first]. Aerie Savings Union has recorded your loan. The payments follow the shift schedule shown in your Finances window. If the figures are hard to read, ask at the members’ desk and we will go through them with you.

bank-aerie-savings-late.title: Aerie Savings Union: A late bill
bank-aerie-savings-late.notes: Started by Phobos Banking on the late event; letters and replies do not change the debt.

message.text: Hi, [player-first]. One of your Aerie bills has gone past its shift. The ledger adds a late fee at every shift change until it is paid. You can see the amount in Finances. Would you like me to note that payment is coming, that you need more time, or that you are not sure?

choices.label: I expect to pay it shortly

message.text: All right. I understand. The bill stays where it is until you pay it through Finances, so please use the amount shown there.

choices.label: Please give me a little time

message.text: I understand. I cannot stop the ledger fee. The amount due is listed in Finances.

choices.label: I do not know when I can pay

message.text: Thank you for saying so plainly. There is no need to make a promise you cannot keep. The bill and its fee remain on the ledger until paid.

bank-aerie-savings-late-long.title: Aerie Savings Union: Still unpaid
bank-aerie-savings-late-long.notes: Started by Phobos Banking on the late-long event; letters and replies do not change the debt.

message.text: I am checking in because your oldest Aerie bill has been unpaid for three days. The ledger keeps adding its late fee at each shift change. Please look at what is due in Finances, and take it one bill at a time if that is what you can manage.

bank-aerie-savings-repaid.title: Aerie Savings Union: Paid in full
bank-aerie-savings-repaid.notes: Started by Phobos Banking on the repaid event; letters and replies do not change the debt.

message.text: That Aerie loan is now paid in full, [player-first]. Thank you for closing the account. I hope the money did what you needed it to do, and that the next shift brings a little more room to breathe.

bank-stillwater-advances-borrowed.title: Stillwater Advances: A new loan
bank-stillwater-advances-borrowed.notes: Started by Phobos Banking on the borrowed event; letters and replies do not change the debt.

message.text: Loan is on the books, [player-first]. Funds are in your account. Your payment schedule is in Finances; check it before the next shift turns over. Stillwater is quick with the paperwork, not magic with the numbers.

bank-stillwater-advances-late.title: Stillwater Advances: A late bill
bank-stillwater-advances-late.notes: Started by Phobos Banking on the late event; letters and replies do not change the debt.

message.text: One of your Stillwater bills missed its shift, [player-first]. The ledger adds a late fee at every shift change until it is paid. Finances has the current amount. Tell me whether you expect to pay soon, need time, or have no date to give.
Good. I hear you. The ledger will not wait for a reply, so make the payment through Finances when you can.

choices.label: I need a little more time

message.text: Understood. I cannot change the bill or the fee. The amount due is in Finances; that is the number to work from.

choices.label: I have no date for you

message.text: Fair enough. Better than inventing one. The debt stays on the ledger until you pay it through Finances.

bank-stillwater-advances-late-long.title: Stillwater Advances: Still unpaid
bank-stillwater-advances-late-long.notes: Started by Phobos Banking on the late-long event; letters and replies do not change the debt.

message.text: Your oldest Stillwater bill has now been unpaid for three days. The late fee keeps adding at every shift change. I will keep this short: check the current amount in Finances and pay what you can there.

bank-stillwater-advances-repaid.title: Stillwater Advances: Paid in full
bank-stillwater-advances-repaid.notes: Started by Phobos Banking on the repaid event; letters and replies do not change the debt.

message.text: That Stillwater loan is closed, [player-first]. Paid in full. The ledger should show no balance left on it. Keep the next schedule where you can find it; nobody gets quicker by guessing.

bank-narrow-ledger-borrowed.title: The Narrow Ledger: A new loan
bank-narrow-ledger-borrowed.notes: Started by Phobos Banking on the borrowed event; letters and replies do not change the debt.

message.text: Your loan is entered, [player-first]. The money is in your account. The shift schedule is in Finances. Read it while you still have the patience; numbers look much the same tomorrow, only larger.

bank-narrow-ledger-late.title: The Narrow Ledger: A late bill
bank-narrow-ledger-late.notes: Started by Phobos Banking on the late event; letters and replies do not change the debt.

message.text: A Narrow Ledger bill has passed its shift. The ledger adds a late fee at every shift change while it stays unpaid. Look in Finances for the amount. Will you say payment is coming, ask for time, or leave the question unanswered?

choices.label: I will pay when I can

message.text: When you can is a time, not a date. I hear you. The balance stays in Finances until you pay it.

choices.label: Put down that I asked for time

message.text: I hear you. The ledger does not read a reply into the bill. Check the amount due in Finances.

choices.label: I have nothing useful to tell you

message.text: Then we agree on one thing. The bill remains on the ledger, and the fee keeps its own hours.

bank-narrow-ledger-late-long.title: The Narrow Ledger: Still unpaid
bank-narrow-ledger-late-long.notes: Started by Phobos Banking on the late-long event; letters and replies do not change the debt.

message.text: The oldest Narrow Ledger bill has been unpaid for three days. The ledger adds its fee every shift. I suggest reading the balance in Finances before it grows any harder to ignore. That is all the advice the counter gives for free.

bank-narrow-ledger-repaid.title: The Narrow Ledger: Paid in full
bank-narrow-ledger-repaid.notes: Started by Phobos Banking on the repaid event; letters and replies do not change the debt.

message.text: Paid in full, [player-first]. The Narrow Ledger has no balance left on that loan. Keep the receipt where you keep the other useful little things.

bank-credit-by-the-shift.label: Credit by the shift
bank-credit-by-the-shift.title: Reading a loan before you take it
bank-credit-by-the-shift.body:
Ogiso's Bank and Ogiso's Register anchor the system's formal credit records. Around them, station lenders offer their own terms: registered houses may ask for standing, while independent counters may ask fewer questions and charge more. A ship or apartment may have a purchase mortgage; a cash loan adds another mortgage line to the ledger.

Check who holds the debt, what the shift schedule says, and what remains outstanding before signing. A lender's interest charge is separate from a late fee on an unpaid bill. The ledger adds the late fee at each shift change until the bill is paid. Letters can remind or explain; they do not move money. Use the Finances window to pay and to check what remains due. A smaller down payment does not make the purchase cost less overall.
